title: Bound exact numerator width in the retained two-FULL caller
body:
This **scoped negative result** proves an exact numerator-width gate for the retained two-FULL caller. Its source has 4,524 paid cuts with independent coarse and fine integer input bands. A literal exact numerator at each marked cut needs leading width `2k`, including when a shared exponent is allowed. Under the stated uniform per-occurrence linear width tariff, charging only the 3,163 original rank-one cuts rejects the complete declared invoice. **The complete kappa calculation does not improve.**

The [proof](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e654d2fcb953698d9d842b3ac78c93b2cc46d23e/research/two-full-exact-width-gate/PROOF.md), [exact result](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e654d2fcb953698d9d842b3ac78c93b2cc46d23e/research/two-full-exact-width-gate/RESULT.json), [complete occurrence certificate](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e654d2fcb953698d9d842b3ac78c93b2cc46d23e/research/two-full-exact-width-gate/WITNESSES.json.gz), and [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e654d2fcb953698d9d842b3ac78c93b2cc46d23e/research/two-full-exact-width-gate/SOURCES.json) state the exact scope. The base and consumed source commit are `32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04`; there is no pending-PR runtime dependency.

The policy fixes a sufficient width at each occurrence for all permitted inputs, funds baseline width `k+o(k)`, and charges linearly in width. **Both native rank and fiber/column multiplicity stay fixed as `k` grows.** Tensor denominator offsets can grow with multiplicity, so no growing-multiplicity limit is claimed. Separate worst-case witnesses do not prove the sum for an adaptive per-input policy. Joint symbolic state, different words, changed helper boundaries, other tariffs, and already funded larger widths remain outside the theorem.

For nonzero dyadic coefficients `p,q`, the values `p A/2^k + q B` have at least `2^(2k-c)` distinct members, where `c=max(0,v2(p)-v2(q))<=2` at the recorded cuts. A reduced odd-numerator argument also gives width `2k-O(1)` despite an exponent field. All helper targets remain credited. The declared bill is:

```text
targets = {4:56,7:14,8:94,9:652,17:224}, mass 10750
raw paid = {1:4656,2:920,3:1386}, mass 10654
width-charged paid = {1:7819,2:920,3:1386}, mass 13817
```

Strict rank separation gives `T_t/P_t <= 10750/13817 < 1` for every `0<=t<=1`. The proof uses only original H1 occurrences; it needs no transfer of width witnesses into higher-rank split factors.

With Python 3.12 and its standard library:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/two-full-exact-width-gate
python3 -O -B research/two-full-exact-width-gate/verify.py
python3 -B research/two-full-exact-width-gate/test_mutations.py
```

The registered command ends with:

```text
PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/two-full-exact-width-gate outcome=negative-result
```

Normal and optimized exact reports match. The retained audit checks all 42,898 events and all 72 warp matrices. The new replay reproduces all 4,524 historical witnesses, checks the 520-column restricted caller input space and every helper return, tests all 75 coefficient pairs, and independently evaluates six source cuts. Four internal controls reject false valuation loss, a zero band, a missing final owned clear, and an integer-to-float receipt change. Isolated normal and optimized processes reject changed source bytes and a changed witness coefficient. The final registered replay, committed-byte check, 12-file export integrity, read-only Git-free export replays, and signed invoice preflight passed.

Cao Yifan supplied the [round-three source and profile](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04/research/kappa-round3-warp-20261022/PROOF.md) in the [PR #4610 lineage](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4610). Yiyang (@Lyy-iiis) supplied the actual caller, boundary substitutions and reused [moving-frame audit](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04/research/two-full-border-paid-precision/independent-review/invariance/REVIEW.md) in [PR #4966](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4966). Its [independent-error proof](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04/research/two-full-border-paid-precision/paid-sensitivity/PROOF.md) is a different tariff premise. Dillon (@dillona) retains the border and recovery credit from [PR #4623](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4623). The additive compatibility result in [PR #4983](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4983), coherent rank gauge in [PR #5106](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5106), and rounded inverse history frontier in [PR #5444](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5444) have distinct scopes, recorded in [the overlap note](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/e654d2fcb953698d9d842b3ac78c93b2cc46d23e/research/two-full-exact-width-gate/OVERLAP.json).

No full physical Gaussian execution, recursive child compatibility, compiler or outer multiplication replay was run. The optional full-history preflight was not run in the shallow checkout. Hosted CI has not run at publication. The proof received author-side parallel agent review, not independent human acceptance. No selected frontier file changes. New work by Ali Romman (@aliromman), with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0, with predecessor credit retained.
